shortDescription: Manage address lists on BIG-IP AFM

options.name: address_lists
options.description: Simple list of existing address lists to add to this list. Address lists can be specified in either their fully qualified name (/Common/foo) or their short name (foo). If a short name is used, the C(partition) argument will automatically be prepended to the short name.

options.name: address_ranges
options.description: A list of address ranges where the range starts with a port number, is followed by a dash (-), and then a second number. If the first address is greater than the second number, the numbers will be reversed so they are properly formatted. For example, C(2.2.2.2-1.1.1). would become C(1.1.1.1-2.2.2.2).

options.name: addresses
options.description: Individual addresses you want to add to the list. These addresses differ from ranges and lists of lists, such as what can be used in C(address_ranges) and C(address_lists) respectively. This list can also include networks that have CIDR notation.

options.name: fqdns
options.description: A list of fully qualified domain names (FQDNs). An FQDN has at least one decimal point in it, separating the host from the domain. To add FQDNs to a list requires that a global FQDN resolver is configured. This must be done using C(bigip_command) or from the GUI of the BIG-IP. If using C(bigip_command), you can do this with C(tmsh modify security firewall global-fqdn-policy FOO) where C(FOO) is a DNS resolver configured at C(tmsh create net dns-resolver FOO).

options.name: geo_locations
options.description: List of geolocations specified by their C(country) and C(region).

options.name: name
options.description: Specifies the name of the address list.

options.name: partition
options.description: Device partition to manage resources on.

options.name: provider
options.description: A dict object containing connection details.

options.name: state
options.description: When C(present), ensures the address list and entries exists. When C(absent), ensures the address list is removed.
